$comment: The island (T-0695): Jarvis over someone else's screen, on the phone (AssistOverlay) and the desktop popup (Popup.svelte). One shape at the top that is a pill, an activity's pill or a card (and on the phone, while the assistant is on, a resting pill on the camera, T-0890), chosen from what is going on. Read by android-app IslandStateTest and jarvis-web island.test.ts; each surface's own function must give every case's state, and its sizes must be these tokens. Does not cover: how a state is drawn or animated (the goldens and e2e/v2-island.spec.ts).

inputs.turn: a voice or typed turn is live: listening, thinking, answering, or its reply still showing
inputs.ask: an approval waits on the person
inputs.notice: a notice arrived and its moment has not run out
inputs.activity: an ongoing activity is held: a route off the car
inputs.expanded: the person opened it: a tap or pull on the pill, the desktop's hotkey
inputs.collapsed: the person flicked it up, out of their way, until something new arrives
inputs.working: the turn is at work on a task: tools running, not just talking (T-0885)
inputs.touched: the person used the phone behind it during this turn: a touch outside the island (T-0885)
inputs.on: the assistant runs on this device and the person keeps its island showing: the phone's wake service with the island setting on (T-0890); the desktop popup never sets it

activity.spoken: {name} has a live update. Tap to open.

places.$comment: Where the phone puts the island (Island.placeFor; the desktop popup has one place). The owner, 2026-11-09: the reactor at the bottom while it talks, and to the island at the top in a smooth move once it goes to a task or the phone is used, as Siri does.
places.bottom: a live turn's card nobody opened from the pill and no activity held
places.placement: a case's "placement": "bottom" is the phone's setting that puts every state at the bottom (T-0968)
places.bare: the state drawn as the core alone, with no box and no words: a live turn's card nobody opened from the pill and no activity held, wherever the setting puts it (T-0912)

cases.name: nothing going on
a turn opens the card
a turn flicked up is the pill, still saying what it does
a turn at work on a task shrinks to its pill at the top
the phone used behind a turn: its pill at the top
a working turn tapped open: its card, at the top
an approval during a task still asks
an approval outranks the turn
an approval cannot be flicked away unanswered
a notice shows on the card for its moment
a notice flicked up is gone
a held route is its pill
a held route, tapped open
a held route flicked away hides, the route still held
a turn over a held route: the turn has the card
a turn flicked up over a held route: the turn's pill
a notice over a held route
opened with nothing going on: the card, ready to be asked
an approval over everything
the assistant on with nothing going on rests at the camera
a flick with the assistant on leaves it resting, not gone
a turn with the assistant on still opens the card
an activity with the assistant on is the activity
with the island at the bottom, a turn at work keeps its pill at the bottom
with the island at the bottom, a card opened there stays there, with its words
with the island at the bottom, a talking turn is still the core alone
